title: The Wright brothers make the first powered airplane flight
summary: Orville Wright flew the Wright Flyer for 12 seconds near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, the first sustained, controlled flight of a powered heavier-than-air aircraft; four flights were made that day.
reason: Wilbur and Orville Wright had spent years studying flight control, building gliders and a wind tunnel, and designing a light engine and propellers.
significance: It began the age of aviation, which transformed travel, trade and war.
place: Kill Devil Hills, North Carolina, United States
